name: Amanata
description: Your first charged hit rolls a blessing. Every 30 charged hits rerolls it. A six grants all five.

name: Hate
description: Every third charged cut and each heavy opens a three-tick bleed.

name: Harmony
description: Heavy hits consume burning, poison, wither and Reaping Spiral bleed for an immediate burst, up to 8 bonus HP.

name: Heat Sword
description: Heavy hits ignite the target and nearby hostile mobs for four seconds.

name: Dual Heat Swords
description: Every second charged cut ignites the target. A heavy releases a short heat wave.

name: Sun & Moon
description: Land two consecutive charged cuts on one target to add 2 HP to the second. Heavy strikes spend the combo.
